modeNote: 2026 turnout comes from the CEC 22:00 election-day turnout report by ballot box (each box's last reported figures), the project owner's chosen primary source. The 22 boxes missing from it use the CEC partial vote count (snapshot 28 Oct 2026, 12:41 UTC). About 2,490 boxes last reported before 21:30 and under-state turnout; they are flagged. Figures will change when final results are published: then point results2026 at the final file, set primary2026 to "count" and mode to "official_final", and run `npm run build:data`.

results2022.label: 2022 results by locality (Knesset 25)
results2022.origin: Central Elections Committee, Knesset 25 final results by locality (expc.csv), supplied by the project owner
results2022.notes: Matches the official national totals: 6,788,804 eligible, 4,794,593 votes, 4,764,742 valid (70.63%).

results2022Boxes.label: 2022 results by ballot box (Knesset 25)
results2022Boxes.origin: Central Elections Committee, Knesset 25 final results by ballot box (expb.csv), supplied by the project owner
results2022Boxes.notes: Used only to cross-check the locality file.

results2026.label: 2026 results by ballot box (Knesset 26, partial count; fallback source)
results2026.origin: Central Elections Committee results feed (media26.bechirot.gov.il/files/expb.csv), as mirrored by the public repository github.com/harelc/elections-vote-transfer (ballot26.csv, commit 8dd817b, 2026-10-28 12:40 UTC; status file: 'Partial count, Central Elections Committee', 11,168 of 12,018 boxes)
results2026.notes: Used only for the boxes missing from the 22:00 turnout report. Partial and unofficial until the CEC publishes final results. Not independently re-downloaded from the CEC (the CEC site is not reachable from the build environment).

feed2026.label: 2026 election-day turnout by ballot box, 22:00 report (primary 2026 source)
feed2026.origin: Central Elections Committee election-day turnout report by ballot box (22:00), supplied by the project owner
feed2026.notes: Primary 2026 turnout source. Windows-1255 encoded. Figures reported by polling-station committees during election day; each box carries the time of its last update, and boxes last updated before 21:30 under-state turnout (flagged). The final row (code 99999, 'מדגם ארצי') is a national sample estimate and is not used for any locality.

roster2026.label: 2026 ballot-box roster
roster2026.origin: Central Elections Committee polling-station list for Knesset 26 (stations.xlsx), as mirrored by github.com/harelc/elections-vote-transfer (data/k26_cec/stations.xlsx); converted with scripts/geo/convert_roster.py
roster2026.notes: 12,018 boxes, 7,331,981 eligible voters. Used only to measure how much of each locality's electorate the 2026 data cover.

geometry.label: Locality boundaries
geometry.origin: Central Bureau of Statistics, statistical areas 2011 with 2019 demography (statisticalareas_demography2019.gdb, cbs.gov.il geo layers), dissolved by locality code with scripts/geo/build_geometry.py
geometry.notes: Polygons are the CBS statistical-area extents of each locality (built-up and attached land), not municipal jurisdiction. Localities founded or recoded after the layer was produced have no polygon.
